110-SECOND GUIDED INVESTIGATION

Record both model threshold times. Calculate time ratio t_A/t_B and separate that comparison from average rate in g/s. These chosen transfer coefficients are teaching assumptions, not measured kitchen-sugar times.

The guide advances 1.5 model seconds per second during its 80-second experiment. Manual playback is 1× model time. Chosen kinetics are not calibrated real-world times. Starting-water levels are reference geometry; solution-volume changes are excluded.
